label: Postgres: Database
description: Run a Postgres database inside your project. Weft brings it up, keeps its disk across restarts, and hands you a connection to wire into the query and write nodes. The database makes its own password and weft never sees it twice; if the connection holding it is ever lost, the node's card has a Reset password button. Terminating this node's infra deletes the disk and everything on it.

inputs.name: database
inputs.label: Database name
inputs.description: The database created the first time this node starts. Changing it later creates nothing: the connection would then name a database that does not exist.

inputs.name: storage
inputs.label: Disk size
inputs.description: How much disk the database gets, read once when it is first created. Changing it here later has no effect; growing a live volume is a manual operation on it, and shrinking one is not possible.

inputs.name: version
inputs.label: Postgres version
inputs.description: The major version to run. Changing it on an existing database will NOT migrate the data: Postgres refuses to start on a data directory written by another major version.

outputs.name: access
outputs.description: The database's access: wire it into the Postgres query and write nodes, exactly like a PostgresAccess node's.
